svg.title: The Western Reaches
svg.desc: A hand-inked fantasy map draws itself: coastlines, mountain ranges, forests, rivers and lettered place names. Then the view zooms in on the village of Bramblecott and follows a dashed red route east past the Ford of Glass, Elderhall, the Gate of Teeth and Ashfall to the smoking Mount Cinder, before pulling back to the whole map.

use.aria-label: Being a map of the long road to Mount Cinder
